name: Needle Scanner
summary: The scanner is part of the automated needle-search line. Check the route of every hay product, not only the main belt, when a needle reaches the selling stand.
version: Community reports (September 2026) and official store description

data.check: Follow each belt and any belt within reach of a robotic arm. Look for a branch that joins the selling route after the scanner. Observe the scanner’s current in-game settings and indicators.
data.community: Players suggest splitting a backed-up line across separate scanners, then joining it afterward. Try a small test before expanding; this does not establish a scanning rate or guaranteed speed increase.
